summary: A production-ready Telegram bot leveraging OpenAI's Assistants API v2 for semantic document search, with asynchronous PostgreSQL persistence, Redis state management, and Amplitude analytics.
key_features: OpenAI Assistants API v2 with Vector Store & File Search
Asynchronous Telegram bot (aiogram 3.x) with Redis-backed FSM
Amplitude analytics integration for user behavior tracking
Alembic database migrations for schema versioning
achievements: Designed and implemented a fully asynchronous, production-ready bot architecture handling concurrent user sessions via Redis FSM and async SQLAlchemy 2.0. Automated OpenAI Vector Store provisioning and domain-specific document ingestion on startup, enabling context-aware semantic search. Engineered robust infrastructure with Docker Compose, Alembic migrations, and secure environment configuration, while integrating Amplitude for real-time analytics and user behavior tracking.
